hints.title: Reverse Query Processing
hints.text: The final front-to-back ordering is determined by the most recent activation time of each window.

hints.title: Deduplication via Set
hints.text: Scan queries backwards. The first time a window id is seen from the right represents its final relative precedence.

hints.title: Untouched Windows Preservation
hints.text: Append any windows never mentioned in queries in their initial order from windows.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Reverse pass over queries followed by scan over initial windows array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Moving elements to front of an array repeatedly takes O(q * w) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(w) set for fast constant-time visited checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reverses perspective from simulating moves forward to collecting latest timestamps backwards.
